Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.persistence

Interface CameraCsvFormat<C extends Camera>

Type Parameters:
C - the exact camera class this format writes and reads back
All Known Implementing Classes:
FixedCameraCsvFormat, PtzCameraCsvFormat
public interface CameraCsvFormat<C extends Camera>
The CSV fields specific to one exact camera class, after the seven shared columns.

CsvGymRepository knows only the shared columns; each camera class brings its own format, so a new kind of camera is stored without touching the repository.

  • Method Details

    • kind

      String kind()
      The word that marks this camera's lines in the file. It must be unique among the registered formats and can be neither gym nor court.
      Returns:
      the kind written in the first column of the camera's line

    • cameraClass

      Class<C> cameraClass()
      The exact class this format handles. A subclass of it is not handled: it needs a format of its own, or saving it fails.
      Returns:
      the camera class this format writes

    • ownColumns

      int ownColumns()
      How many columns follow the shared ones on this camera's line. Loading checks every line against it before calling build(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.enums.Resolution, int, java.util.List<java.lang.String>).
      Returns:
      the number of fields ownFields(C) returns, never negative

    • ownFields

      List<String> ownFields(C camera)
      The values specific to this camera, in the order build(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.enums.Resolution, int, java.util.List<java.lang.String>) reads them back.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera being saved
      Returns:
      exactly ownColumns() fields, none containing a comma or a line break

    • build

      C build(String id, String model, Resolution resolution, int bufferSeconds, List<String> ownFields)
      Rebuilds a camera from its stored fields, through the domain's own constructors and behaviour, so a stored value the camera would refuse is refused again here.
      Parameters:
      id - the camera's identifier
      model - the camera's model
      resolution - the resolution it records at
      bufferSeconds - the length of its circular buffer
      ownFields - the fields ownFields(C) wrote, already counted
      Returns:
      the rebuilt camera, still switched off
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a field is not a value the camera accepts
